description: Record the domain the creator wants in front of their page and return the DNS record to add. Part of Premium. Replaces any domain already recorded, including a working one, which then stops serving until verify_custom_domain passes again, so confirm with the creator if a domain is already active. This does not touch DNS or make the domain work: the creator adds the record at their registrar, then verify_custom_domain checks it.
name: set_custom_domain

target.description: What the DNS record has to point at.

title: Connect my own domain
